source: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Advanced Hunting tables, lab case-05 (2026-06-26)
device_filter: DeviceName in~ ('desktop-ceo.corp.local','desktop-hr.corp.local') (case-insensitive; one DeviceEvents row is spelled desktop-hr.CORP.local)
alerts_window: 2026-06-26T00:00:00Z to 2026-06-28T00:00:00Z (AlertEvidence only, widened one day for late alert rows)
row_count_verification: CSV rows + excluded_rows per table == the original Defender export, all 8 tables, re-checked after sanitization
excluded_reason: Defender's own activity removed: every process descended from MsSense.exe / SenseIR.exe (they carry tenant identifiers), and MpCmdRun.exe GetDeviceTicket runs (per-run access keys); plus network rows to the home ISP's content-cache servers (they identify the ISP)
sanitize_map: domain -> corp.local (host names kept), private IPs -> 172.16.x.y, local admin -> ladmin, DeviceId/SID/AlertId/AD domain GUID/alert MergeByKey re-mapped 1:1; operator 172.190.5.225 verbatim (our test Azure lab VM)
